details.copy: Create an elevated digital experience and flexible e-commerce solution that can adapt to the evolving needs of Aplós and the growing audience for non-alcoholic drinks.
The site evokes natural luxury. Influenced by an editorial balance between expansive and intimate photography, the layouts invite the curious to sit, stay a while, and consider something new.

image.alt: Organic shape made up of smaller elements in front of bubbles moving through liquid.
Animation depicting the menu opening, and the browser becoming smaller, highlighting the unique menu design.
A layout with very large and small text showing the difference of scale within the type system.
A grid of interactive cards and sliders cycle between information.
A layout shows an expanding table of recipes on the left, and a photo of a cocktail surrounded lychees on the right.
A scroll-through of the product page, with editorial and practical information.

imageRight.alt: Two people in white shirts and khakis hula-hooping against a blue sky.

mediaLeft.alt: A vertical menu containing pictures of the Aplós bottle over a close up of a carbonated beverage.

image.alt: Organic shapes made up of smaller points shift and move. A UI shows the animations changing how they shift, and how fast.
A cart UI sits over a mostly-blue image depicting a frog in motion. The UI cycles through an empty cart state, then shows a product added and an upsell.
UI elements layered over vibey images of people and the product drift across the screen. The UI elements depict information about the bottle, and empty cart state with an illustration, and more.

imageLeft.alt: A cocktail surrounded by bartenders tools and ingredients.

mediaRight.alt: Animation showing a dandelion bloom slowly growing from nothing.

image.alt: shopping UI over a bubbling beverage background

meta.description: A digital design system and e-commerce site for a new kind of non-alcoholic beverage.
